verdict.rationale: LanceDB's storage layer runs on local NVMe/EBS/EFS or any S3-compatible object store, which implies users can choose where to host their bucket/region since they control the underlying storage target, but there is no explicit documentation addressing data residency or region selection as a feature. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection docs, enterprise data-residency guarantees, and independent confirmation of regional deployment options.
